title: Plugin Manifest v1
description: The contract a plugin declares so the pipeline can load it without knowing its internals. A plugin is a source adapter, an emitter, a sink, or a deployer; `emits` says which.

irRange.description: Semver range of Site IR versions this plugin accepts or produces, e.g. `^1.0.0`.

emits.description: Artifact kinds this plugin produces. A source adapter emits `site-ir`; an emitter emits a site artifact; a deployer emits a deployment.

sinks.description: Submission targets this plugin can emit or consume. Required only for form-sink plugins.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks the pipeline will call, in `phase:name` form.

assets.description: Files the plugin ships beside its code (templates, golden payloads, migration SQL). Paths are plugin-relative.

runbook.description: Path to this plugin's operator runbook, markdown.

configSchema.description: Plugin-relative path to the JSON Schema for its own configuration.

entrypoint.description: Plugin-relative path to the module the pipeline imports.
